claims.event: The Joseon kingship passed from Wiman to this unnamed son and then to grandson Ugeo

units.zh: 朝鮮王滿者，故燕人也。
units.en: Wiman, the king of Joseon, was originally a man of the state of Yan.
units.literal: King Wiman of Joseon was originally a man of Yan.

units.zh: 自始全燕時嘗略屬真番、朝鮮，為置吏，筑鄣塞。
units.en: In the early days, when Yan was still whole, it had conquered and laid claim to Zhendan and Joseon, appointing officials there and constructing border fortifications.
units.literal: From the time when Yan was still whole, it had often subdued and brought Zhendan and Joseon under its control, appointing officials there and building barrier forts.

units.zh: 秦滅燕，屬遼東外徼。
units.en: After the Qin destroyed Yan, the region was placed under the outer frontier of Liaodong.
units.literal: Qin destroyed Yan, and it became part of the outer defenses of Liaodong.

units.zh: 漢興，為其遠難守，復修遼東故塞，至浿水為界，屬燕。
units.en: When the Han dynasty arose, the court considered the territory too remote and difficult to defend. They restored the old Liaodong border fortifications, setting the Pae River as the boundary, and placed the region under the Kingdom of Yan.
units.literal: When Han arose, because the region was distant and difficult to defend, they restored the old Liaodong border fortifications, set the Pae River as the boundary, and placed the region under Yan.

units.zh: 燕王盧綰反，入匈奴，滿亡命，聚黨千餘人，魋結蠻夷服而東走出塞，渡浿水，居秦故空地上下鄣，稍役屬真番、朝鮮蠻夷及故燕、齊亡命者王之，都王險。
units.en: When Lu Wan, the King of Yan, rose in rebellion and fled to the Xiongnu, Wiman went into exile. He gathered more than a thousand followers, tied up their hair in the fashion of the eastern barbarians, donned barbarian clothing, and fled east beyond the frontier passes. After crossing the Pae River, he settled in the abandoned Qin territories between the upper and lower fortifications, and gradually brought the barbarians of Zhendan and Joseon under his rule, along with refugees from the former states of Yan and Qi. He made himself their king and established his capital at Wanggeom.
units.literal: When the King of Yan, Lu Wan, rebelled and fled to the Xiongnu, Wiman went into exile, gathered more than a thousand followers, tied up their hair in barbarian fashion and wore barbarian clothing, fled east out of the passes, crossed the Pae River, and settled in the old Qin empty lands between the upper and lower barriers, gradually bringing Zhendan, Joseon barbarians, and former Yan and Qi fugitives under his rule and making himself their king, with his capital at Wanggeom.

units.zh: 會孝惠、高后時天下初定，遼東太守即約滿為外臣，保塞外蠻夷，無使盜邊；
units.en: It happened that during the reigns of Emperor Hui and Empress Dowager Gao, when the empire had only just been pacified, the Governor of Liaodong made an agreement with Wiman to serve as an outer vassal. He was charged with keeping the barbarians beyond the frontier in check and preventing them from raiding the border.
units.literal: It happened that during the reigns of Emperor Hui and Empress Dowager Gao, when the empire had only just been pacified, the Governor of Liaodong made an agreement with Wiman for him to serve as an outer vassal, protecting the barbarians beyond the frontier and preventing them from raiding the border;

units.zh: 諸蠻夷君長欲入見天子，勿得禁止。
units.en: In return, any barbarian chieftains who wished to travel to the capital for an audience with the Son of Heaven were not to be obstructed.
units.literal: Any barbarian chiefs who wished to enter and see the Son of Heaven should not be prohibited.

units.zh: 以聞，上許之，以故滿得兵威財物侵降其旁小邑，真番、臨屯皆來服屬，方數千里。
units.en: When this arrangement was reported to the throne, the emperor approved it. Armed with this mandate, Wiman used his military power and wealth to invade and subjugate the smaller settlements around him. Before long, Zhendan and Lintun had all submitted to his authority, and his domain stretched over several thousand li.
units.literal: This was reported to the emperor, who approved it, so Wiman used military might and wealth to invade and subjugate neighboring small settlements, and Zhendan and Lintun all came to submit and belong to him, his domain covering several thousand li on a side.

units.zh: 傳子至孫右渠，所誘漢亡人滋多，又未嘗入見；
units.en: The throne passed to his son and then to his grandson, Ugeo. Under Ugeo's rule, ever more Han fugitives were lured into the kingdom, yet he never once traveled to court to pay his respects.
units.literal: The throne passed to his son and then to his grandson Ugeo, who lured ever more Han fugitives into the kingdom, yet never once went to court to pay his respects;

units.zh: 真番旁眾國欲上書見天子，又擁閼不通。
units.en: When the neighboring states near Zhendan wished to send memorials requesting an audience with the Son of Heaven, Ugeo blocked their way and refused to let them through.
units.literal: When the neighboring states near Zhendan wished to submit memorials requesting an audience with the Son of Heaven, Ugeo blocked and obstructed them.

units.zh: 元封二年，漢使涉何譙諭右渠，終不肯奉詔。
units.en: In the second year of the Yuanfeng era, the Han court dispatched the envoy She He to rebuke Ugeo, but the king stubbornly refused to obey the imperial edict.
units.literal: In the second year of the Yuanfeng era, Han sent She He to reproach Ugeo, but he ultimately refused to obey the imperial edict.

units.zh: 何去至界上，臨浿水，使御刺殺送何者朝鮮裨王長，即渡，馳入塞，遂歸報天子曰「殺朝鮮將」。
units.en: As She He departed and reached the border at the Pae River, he ordered his chariot driver to stab and kill the Joseon deputy king, Chang, who had been escorting him. He then immediately crossed the river and galloped back through the frontier passes to report to the Son of Heaven: 'I have slain a Joseon general.'
units.literal: She He left and reached the border at the Pae River, had his chariot driver stab and kill the Joseon deputy king Chang who was escorting him, then immediately crossed, galloped into the passes, and returned to report to the Son of Heaven, saying, "I have killed a Joseon general."

units.zh: 上為其名美，即不詰，拜何為遼東東部都尉。
units.en: The emperor, pleased by the impressive claim, did not investigate the matter further and appointed She He as the Commandant of the Eastern Division of Liaodong.
units.literal: The emperor, for the beauty of his claim, did not investigate, and appointed He as the Commandant of the Eastern Division of Liaodong.

units.zh: 朝鮮怨何，發兵襲攻殺何。
units.en: The Joseon court, outraged by this treachery, dispatched troops to attack and kill She He.
units.literal: Joseon resented He, sent troops to attack and kill him.

units.zh: 天子募罪人擊朝鮮。
units.en: The Son of Heaven recruited convicted criminals to form an army against Joseon.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven recruited criminals to attack Joseon.

units.zh: 其秋，遣樓船將軍楊仆從齊浮渤海；
units.en: That autumn, the emperor dispatched the General of the Tower Ships, Yang Pu, to sail from Qi across the Bohai Sea.
units.literal: That autumn, he sent the Tower Ship General Yang Pu from Qi by sea across the Bohai;

units.zh: 兵五萬人，左將軍荀彘出遼東：討右渠。
units.en: With a combined force of fifty thousand men, and the Left General, Xun Zhi, marching overland from Liaodong, they set out to punish Ugeo.
units.literal: With 50,000 troops, and the Left General Xun Zhi from Liaodong, to attack Ugeo.

units.zh: 右渠發兵距險。
units.en: Ugeo deployed his troops to hold the mountain passes.
units.literal: Ugeo sent troops to defend the dangerous passes.

units.zh: 左將軍卒正多率遼東兵先縱，敗散，多還走，坐法斬。
units.en: The Left General's battalion commander, Duo, led the Liaodong troops in an early charge, but they were routed and scattered. Many of the men fled in retreat, and Duo was executed under military law.
units.literal: The Left General's battalion commander, Duo, led the Liaodong troops in a rash advance, but they were defeated and scattered; many retreated and fled, and Duo was executed under military law.

units.zh: 樓船將軍將齊兵七千人先至王險。
units.en: The General of the Tower Ships led seven thousand Qi soldiers and reached Wanggeom first.
units.literal: The Tower Ship General led 7,000 Qi troops and arrived first at Wanggeom Fortress.

units.zh: 右渠城守，窺知樓船軍少，即出城擊樓船，樓船軍敗散走。
units.en: Ugeo held fast within the city walls. When he saw that the Tower Ships force was small, he sallied forth to attack them. The Tower Ships army was defeated and scattered in flight.
units.literal: Ugeo defended the city, saw that the tower ship army was small, immediately came out of the city to attack the tower ships; the tower ship army was defeated and scattered in flight.

units.zh: 將軍楊仆失其眾，遁山中十餘日，稍求收散卒，復聚。
units.en: General Yang Pu lost his men and fled into the mountains, where he hid for more than ten days. Gradually, he managed to round up his scattered soldiers and reassemble them.
units.literal: General Yang Pu lost his troops, fled into the mountains for over ten days, gradually gathered the scattered soldiers, and reformed them.

units.zh: 左將軍擊朝鮮浿水西軍，未能破自前。
units.en: The Left General attacked the Joseon forces west of the Pae River but could not defeat them and advance.
units.literal: The Left General attacked the Joseon army west of the Pae River but could not defeat it and advance.

units.zh: 天子為兩將未有利，乃使衛山因兵威往諭右渠。
units.en: Since neither general had gained the upper hand, the Son of Heaven sent Wei Shan to use the might of the army as leverage and persuade Ugeo to submit.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven, because neither general had achieved victory, sent Wei Shan to use the army's might to persuade Ugeo.

units.zh: 右渠見使者頓首謝：「願降，恐兩將詐殺臣；
units.en: Ugeo received the envoy and bowed his head in apology. 'I am willing to surrender,' he said, 'but I fear the two generals will use treachery to kill me.
units.literal: Ugeo saw the envoy and bowed his head in apology: 'I wish to surrender, but fear the two generals will deceitfully kill me;

units.zh: 今見信節，請服降。」
units.en: Now that I have seen the imperial credential, I am ready to submit.'
units.literal: Now seeing the trustworthy tally, I request to submit and surrender.'

units.zh: 遣太子入謝，獻馬五千匹，及饋軍糧。
units.en: He sent his crown prince to make a formal apology, presenting five thousand horses and supplies of grain for the army.
units.literal: He sent his crown prince to apologize, offering five thousand horses, and supplying army provisions.

units.zh: 人眾萬餘，持兵，方渡浿水，使者及左將軍疑其為變，謂太子已服降，宜命人毋持兵。
units.en: The prince arrived with a retinue of more than ten thousand men, all bearing arms, and was about to cross the Pae River. The envoy and the Left General, suspecting a ruse, told the prince that since he had already agreed to surrender, his people should lay down their weapons.
units.literal: With a crowd of over ten thousand people bearing arms, when they were about to cross the Pae River, the envoy and Left General suspected they would rebel, told the crown prince that since he had already submitted, the people should not bear arms.

units.zh: 太子亦疑使者左將軍詐殺之，遂不渡浿水，復引歸。
units.en: The crown prince, in turn, suspected that the envoy and the Left General were plotting to kill him, and so refused to cross the Pae River. He led his men back the way they had come.
units.literal: The crown prince also suspected the envoy and Left General would deceitfully kill him, so did not cross the Pae River, and led them back again.

units.zh: 山還報天子，天子誅山。
units.en: Wei Shan returned and reported on the failed negotiations. The Son of Heaven had him executed.
units.literal: Shan returned and reported to the Son of Heaven, who executed Shan.

units.zh: 左將軍破浿水上軍，乃前，至城下，圍其西北。
units.en: The Left General defeated the forces on the upper Pae River, then pressed forward to the city walls and laid siege to the northwest.
units.literal: The Left General broke the army above the Pae River, then advanced to the city walls, surrounding the northwest.

units.zh: 樓船亦往會，居城南。
units.en: The General of the Tower Ships also came to join the siege, stationing his forces south of the city.
units.literal: The tower ships also went to join, stationed south of the city.

units.zh: 右渠遂堅守城，數月未能下。
units.en: Ugeo dug in and stubbornly defended the city. After several months, it still could not be taken.
units.literal: Ugeo thus firmly defended the city; after several months it could not be taken.

units.zh: 左將軍素侍中，幸，將燕代卒，悍，乘勝，軍多驕。
units.en: The Left General had once served as an attendant at court and enjoyed the emperor's favor. He commanded soldiers from Yan and Dai—fierce men flushed with victory—and his army had grown arrogant.
units.literal: The Left General had formerly been a palace attendant, was favored, commanded Yan and Dai troops, who were fierce, rode on victory, the army was mostly arrogant.

units.zh: 樓船將齊卒，入海，固已多敗亡；
units.en: The General of the Tower Ships, commanding troops from Qi who had crossed the sea, had already suffered heavy losses.
units.literal: The tower ship general commanded Qi troops who entered by sea, had already suffered many defeats and losses;

units.zh: 其先與右渠戰，因辱亡卒，卒皆恐，將心慚，其圍右渠，常持和節。
units.en: In their earlier battle against Ugeo, they had shamed and abused their fleeing soldiers, leaving the troops fearful and the general ashamed. During the siege, he frequently displayed credentials of peace.
units.literal: In their earlier battle against Ugeo, they distressed and humiliated the soldiers who had fled; the troops were all fearful and the general was ashamed; while besieging Ugeo, they often displayed credentials of peace.

units.zh: 左將軍急擊之，朝鮮大臣乃陰閒使人私約降樓船，往來言，尚未肯決。
units.en: While the Left General pressed the attack, the senior ministers of Joseon secretly dispatched envoys to negotiate a private surrender to the General of the Tower Ships. Messages passed back and forth, but no final agreement was reached.
units.literal: The Left General urgently attacked, the Joseon ministers secretly sent people to privately agree to surrender to the tower ships, coming and going with messages, but not yet willing to decide.

units.zh: 左將軍數與樓船期戰，樓船欲急就其約，不會；
units.en: The Left General repeatedly scheduled joint attacks with the Tower Ships forces, but the Tower Ships general, eager to finalize his private agreement with Joseon, failed to appear.
units.literal: The Left General repeatedly made battle appointments with the tower ships, the tower ships wished to quickly fulfill their agreement, did not meet;

units.zh: 左將軍亦使人求閒卻降下朝鮮，朝鮮不肯，心附樓船：以故兩將不相能。
units.en: The Left General also sent agents to secretly persuade the Joseon court to surrender to him, but they refused, their loyalty inclined toward the Tower Ships general. For this reason, the two commanders could no longer work together.
units.literal: The Left General also sent people to seek to secretly persuade Joseon to surrender, Joseon refused, their hearts attached to the tower ships: therefore the two generals could not cooperate.

units.zh: 左將軍心意樓船前有失軍罪，今與朝鮮私善而又不降，疑其有反計，未敢發。
units.en: The Left General harbored suspicions: the Tower Ships general had previously committed the offense of losing his army and was now secretly colluding with Joseon while refusing to compel their surrender. He suspected the man of harboring treasonous designs but dared not act.
units.literal: The Left General thought: the Tower Ships general had earlier committed the offense of losing his army; now he was on friendly terms with Joseon in secret and still would not bring about their surrender; he suspected him of harboring treasonous designs but did not dare to act.

units.zh: 天子曰將率不能，前（及）［乃］使衛山諭降右渠，右渠遣太子，山使不能剸決，與左將軍計相誤，卒沮約。
units.en: The Son of Heaven declared that the commanders could not advance, and then sent Wei Shan to negotiate Ugeo's surrender. Ugeo dispatched his crown prince in response, but Wei Shan failed to handle the matter decisively; his actions clashed with the Left General's plans, and in the end the agreement fell through.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven said the commanders could not advance, and then sent Wei Shan to persuade Ugeo to surrender; Ugeo sent his crown prince, but Shan could not decide the matter decisively, clashed with the Left General's plans, and ultimately ruined the agreement.

units.zh: 今兩將圍城，又乖異，以故久不決。
units.en: Now the two generals were besieging the city yet remained at odds, and for this reason the campaign dragged on without resolution.
units.literal: Now the two generals surround the city, but are at odds, therefore long undecided.

units.zh: 使濟南太守公孫遂往（征）［正］之，有便宜得以從事。
units.en: He dispatched Gongsun Sui, the Governor of Jinan, to set matters right, granting him full authority to act as he saw fit.
units.literal: Sent the Jinan governor Gongsun Sui to correct it, with discretion to handle affairs.

units.zh: 遂至，左將軍曰：「朝鮮當下久矣，不下者有狀。」
units.en: When Gongsun Sui arrived, the Left General told him, 'Joseon should have fallen long ago. There is a reason it has not.'
units.literal: Sui arrived, the Left General said: 'Joseon should have surrendered long ago, not surrendering has a reason.'

units.zh: 言樓船數期不會，具以素所意告遂，曰：「今如此不取，恐為大害，非獨樓船，又且與朝鮮共滅吾軍。」
units.en: He described how the Tower Ships general had repeatedly failed to keep their battle appointments, laid out all his longstanding suspicions, and said, 'If we do not act now, I fear the consequences will be dire. The Tower Ships general may not only refuse to fight—he may join forces with Joseon to destroy our army.'
units.literal: He told Sui about the tower ships repeatedly not meeting appointments, fully informed him of his longstanding suspicions, saying: 'Now like this not taking it, I fear it will become a great harm, not only the tower ships, but also together with Joseon will destroy our army.'

units.zh: 遂亦以為然，而以節召樓船將軍入左將軍營計事，即命左將軍麾下執捕樓船將軍，并其軍，以報天子。
units.en: Gongsun Sui agreed. Using the imperial tally, he summoned the General of the Tower Ships to the Left General's camp to discuss strategy. Once there, he ordered the Left General's officers to seize and arrest the Tower Ships general, absorbed his troops, and sent a report to the Son of Heaven.
units.literal: Sui also thought it so, and used the tally to summon the tower ship general into the Left General's camp to discuss matters, immediately ordered the Left General's subordinates to arrest the tower ship general and his army, reporting to the Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 天子誅遂。
units.en: The Son of Heaven had Gongsun Sui executed.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven executed Sui.

units.zh: 左將軍已并兩軍，即急擊朝鮮。
units.en: Having now combined both armies under his command, the Left General launched an all-out assault on Joseon.
units.literal: The Left General already combined the two armies, immediately urgently attacked Joseon.

units.zh: 朝鮮相路人、相韓陰、尼谿相參、將軍王唊相與謀曰：「始欲降樓船，樓船今執，獨左將軍并將，戰益急，恐不能與，（戰）王又不肯降。」
units.en: The Joseon Chancellor Lu Ren, Chancellor Han Yin, the Chancellor of Nixi, Shen, and General Wang Xia plotted together. 'We had intended to surrender to the Tower Ships general,' they said, 'but now he has been arrested. The Left General alone commands both armies, the fighting grows fiercer by the day, and we fear we cannot hold out—yet the king still refuses to surrender.'
units.literal: The Joseon chancellor Lu Ren, Chancellor Han Yin, the Chancellor of Nixi, Shen, and General Wang Xia plotted together, saying, "We had at first wished to surrender to the Tower Ships general, but he has now been arrested. The Left General alone commands both armies, the fighting grows fiercer by the day, and we fear we cannot hold out—yet the king still refuses to surrender."

units.zh: 陰、唊、路人皆亡降漢。
units.en: Han Yin, Wang Xia, and Lu Ren all deserted and surrendered to the Han.
units.literal: Yin, Xia, and Lu Ren all fled and surrendered to Han.

units.zh: 路人道死。
units.en: Lu Ren died on the road.
units.literal: Lu Ren died en route.

units.zh: 元封三年夏，尼谿相參乃使人殺朝鮮王右渠來降。
units.en: In the summer of the third year of the Yuanfeng era, Shen, the Chancellor of Nixi, sent men to assassinate King Ugeo of Joseon and came to surrender.
units.literal: In the summer of the third year of the Yuanfeng era, Shen, the Chancellor of Nixi, sent men to kill King Ugeo of Joseon and came to surrender.

units.zh: 王險城未下，故右渠之大臣成巳又反，復攻吏。
units.en: But the fortress of Wanggeom had not yet fallen. Cheng Ji, one of Ugeo's former ministers, raised another rebellion and turned his forces against the Han officials.
units.literal: Wanggeom Fortress was not yet taken; therefore Ugeo's minister Cheng Ji again rebelled and attacked the officials again.

units.zh: 左將軍使右渠子長降、相路人之子最告諭其民，誅成巳，以故遂定朝鮮，為四郡。
units.en: The Left General had Ugeo's son, Changjiang, surrender and had Lu Ren's son, Zui, issue a proclamation to the people. He executed Cheng Ji, and with this, Joseon was at last pacified and divided into four commanderies.
units.literal: The Left General had Ugeo's son Changjiang surrender and had Lu Ren's son Zui proclaim and instruct the people; he executed Cheng Ji, and thereby finally pacified Joseon and established four commanderies.

units.zh: 封參為澅清侯，陰為荻苴侯，唊為平州侯，長［降］為幾侯。
units.en: Shen was enfeoffed as the Marquis of Huaqing, Han Yin as the Marquis of Diqu, Wang Xia as the Marquis of Pingzhou, and Chang as the Marquis of Ji.
units.literal: Shen was enfeoffed as Marquis of Huaqing, Han Yin as Marquis of Diqu, Wang Xia as Marquis of Pingzhou, and Chang as Marquis of Ji.

units.zh: 最以父死頗有功，為溫陽侯。
units.en: Zui, because his father had died in loyal service and earned considerable merit, was made the Marquis of Wenyang.
units.literal: Zui, because his father died and had considerable merit, became Marquis of Wenyang.

units.zh: 左將軍徵至，坐爭功相嫉，乖計，棄市。
units.en: The Left General was recalled to the capital. He was charged with disputing credit, jealousy toward his colleague, and disobedience of orders, and was publicly executed.
units.literal: The Left General was summoned, sat for disputing merit and being jealous, conflicting plans, and was executed in the marketplace.

units.zh: 樓船將軍亦坐兵至洌口，當待左將軍，擅先縱，失亡多，當誅，贖為庶人。
units.en: The General of the Tower Ships was also charged: when his troops reached Liekou, he should have waited for the Left General but instead launched an unauthorized attack and suffered heavy losses. He deserved execution but was permitted to pay a fine and was reduced to commoner status.
units.literal: The Tower Ships general was also charged: when his troops reached Liekou, he should have waited for the Left General but presumptuously charged first, suffered heavy losses, deserved execution, and was permitted to ransom his life and was reduced to commoner status.

units.zh: 太史公曰：右渠負固，國以絕祀。
units.en: The Grand Historian remarks: Ugeo relied on stubborn resistance, and his state was destroyed, its sacrifices cut off.
units.literal: The Grand Historian said: Ugeo relied on stubborn resistance, and his state thereby lost its sacrifices.

units.zh: 涉何誣功，為兵發首。
units.en: She He fabricated his exploits and so lit the fuse for war.
units.literal: She He fabricated merit, became the first to send troops.

units.zh: 樓船將狹，及難離咎。
units.en: The General of the Tower Ships was a man of narrow vision, and when trouble came, he could not escape blame.
units.literal: The tower ship general was narrow-minded, met difficulty and shared blame.

units.zh: 悔失番禺，乃反見疑。
units.en: Regretting his failure at Panyu, he swung to the opposite extreme and fell under suspicion.
units.literal: Regretted losing Panyu, then returned and was suspected.

units.zh: 荀彘爭勞，與遂皆誅。
units.en: Xun Zhi quarreled over credit, and together with Gongsun Sui, both were put to death.
units.literal: Xun Zhi disputed merit, with Sui were both executed.

units.zh: 兩軍俱辱，將率莫侯矣。
units.en: Both armies were disgraced, and not a single general was enfeoffed.
units.literal: Both armies were humiliated, the generals were not enfeoffed.

units.zh: 漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華。
units.en: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.
units.literal: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.

units.zh: 群臣從至，上議曰：「丞相臣平、太尉臣勃、大將軍臣武、御史大夫臣蒼、宗正臣郢、朱虛侯臣章、東牟侯臣興居、典客臣揭再拜言大王足下：子弘等皆非孝惠皇帝子，不當奉宗廟。
units.en: The ministers followed and arrived. The court deliberated, saying: "Chancellor Chen Ping, Grand Commandant Zhou Bo, General-in-Chief Chai Wu, Grandee Secretary Zhang Cang, Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Ying, Marquis Zhu Xu Liu Zhang, Marquis Dong Mou Liu Xingju, and Court Receptionist Liu Jie bowed twice and addressed Your Majesty: Zi Hong and the others are not sons of Emperor Xiaohui and should not serve at the ancestral temple.
units.literal: The ministers followed and arrived. The court deliberated, saying: "Chancellor Chen Ping, Grand Commandant Zhou Bo, General-in-Chief Chai Wu, Grandee Secretary Zhang Cang, Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Ying, Marquis Zhu Xu Liu Zhang, Marquis Dong Mou Liu Xingju, and Court Receptionist Liu Jie bowed twice and addressed Your Majesty: Zi Hong and the others are not sons of Emperor Xiaohui and ought not serve at the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 二月，出孝惠皇帝後宮美人，令得嫁。
units.en: In the second month, he released the palace ladies from Emperor Hui's harem and allowed them to marry.
units.literal: Second month, he released the beautiful women from the harem of Emperor Hui and permitted them to marry.

units.zh: 駙馬都尉置由漢武，[9]或以假諸功臣，或以加於戚屬，是以魏曹植表駙馬、奉車趣為一號。
units.en: The consort commandant was created by Han Wudi; [9] it was sometimes given to meritorious ministers and sometimes to kin—hence Cao Zhi in Wei asked to merge consort commandant and carriage attendant into one title.
units.literal: The post of Commandant of the Consort's Carriage was established by Emperor Wu of Han; [9] sometimes it was lent to meritorious ministers, sometimes added for kin—hence in Wei, Cao Zhi petitioned to make the consort commandant and the carriage attendant a single title.

units.zh: 駙馬都尉置由漢武 「由」字原本漫漶，今據各本補。
units.en: On "consort commandant established by Han Wudi": the character you was faded in the base text and is restored from other editions.
units.literal: The post of Commandant of the Consort's Carriage was established by Emperor Wu of Han—the character "by" in the original was effaced; it is now supplied from the various editions.

units.zh: 呂公女即呂后也，生孝惠帝、魯元公主。
units.en: This daughter of Lü Gong would become Empress Lü. She gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan.
units.literal: Lü Gong's daughter was namely Empress Lü, gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan.

units.zh: 呂后與兩子居田中，有一老父過請飲，呂后因餔之。
units.en: Empress Lü lived in the countryside with their two children. An old man passed by and asked for a drink. Empress Lü fed him.
units.literal: Empress Lü and the two children resided in the fields, there was an old father who passed by requesting drink, Empress Lü because of this fed him.

units.zh: 老父相后曰：「夫人天下貴人也。」
units.en: The old man read Empress Lü's face and said: "Madame, you are a noble person of the world."
units.literal: The old father read Empress Lü's face and said: "Madame is a noble person of the world."

units.zh: 老父已去，高祖適從旁舍來，呂后具言客有過，相我子母皆大貴。
units.en: The old man had already left. Emperor Gaozu had just returned from a neighboring house. Empress Lü told him everything: a guest had passed by and read the faces of her, the children, and her mother—they were all greatly noble.
units.literal: The old man had already left; Gaozu had just come from the neighboring house. Empress Lü told him in full that a guest had passed by and read the faces of her and her children—all were greatly noble.

units.zh: 高祖隱於芒、碭山澤間，呂后與人俱求，常得之。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu hid in the mountains and marshes between Mang and Dang. Empress Lü and others searched for him together and always found him.
units.literal: Gaozu hid in the mountains and marshes between Mang and Dang, Empress Lu and others together sought him, constantly found him.

units.zh: 呂后曰：「季所居上常有雲氣，故從往常得季。」
units.en: Empress Lü said: "There are always clouds above where you stay. That's why we can always find you by following them."
units.literal: Empress Lu said: 'Where Ji resides above constantly has cloud aura, therefore following it constantly finds Ji.'

units.zh: 審食其從太公、呂后間行，反遇楚軍，羽常置軍中以為質。
units.en: Shen Yiji escorted the Venerable Sire and Empress Lü along hidden paths, but they encountered Chu troops. Xiang Yu kept them with the army as hostages.
units.literal: Shen Yiji secretly escorted the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü, but encountered Chu troops. Xiang Yu constantly kept them in the army as hostages.

units.zh: 呂后兄周呂侯將兵居下邑，漢王往從之。
units.en: Empress Lü's elder brother Zhou Lühou led troops stationed at Xiayi. King Han went to join him.
units.literal: Empress Lü's elder brother Zhou Lühou led troops stationed at Xiayi. King Han went to join him.

units.zh: 九月，歸太公、呂后，軍皆稱萬歲。
units.en: In the ninth month, he returned the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü. The army all shouted ten thousand years.
units.literal: In the ninth month, he returned the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü. The army all shouted ten thousand years.

units.zh: 卒與高祖。
units.en: In the end, she married Emperor Gaozu.
units.literal: In the end he married with the Supreme Ancestor.

units.zh: 九月，漢王遣將軍薛歐、王吸出武關，因王陵兵，從南陽迎太公、呂后於沛。
units.en: In the ninth month, the King of Han sent Generals Xue Ou and Wang Xi out through Wuguan to join Wang Ling's troops and proceed from Nanyang to Pei to escort the Venerable Sire and Empress Lü.
units.literal: In the ninth month, King Han sent generals Xue Ou and Wang Xi out of Wuguan, relying on Wang Ling's troops, going from Nanyang to welcome the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü from Pei.

units.zh: 臣有息女，願為箕帚妾。」
units.en: I have a young daughter and wish to make her Ji's humble servant."
units.literal: I have a young daughter, wish to make her Ji's broom and dustpan servant."

units.zh: 酒罷，呂媼怒呂公曰：「公始常欲奇此女，與貴人。
units.en: After the wine ended, Lü Po angrily confronted Lü Gong: "You always said this daughter was exceptional and should marry someone noble.
units.literal: The wine ended, Lü Po became angry at Lü Gong and said: "You at first constantly wished to treat this daughter as exceptional, to match her with a noble person.

units.zh: 令相兩子，見孝惠帝，曰：「夫人所以貴者，乃此男也。」
units.en: He had him read the faces of the two children. When he saw Emperor Xiaohui, he said: "Madame's nobility comes from this male child."
units.literal: She had him read the faces of the two children; when he saw Emperor Xiaohui, he said: "Madame's nobility comes from this male child."

units.zh: 老父曰：「鄉者夫人兒子皆以君，君相貴不可言。」
units.en: The old man said: "Just now, Madame and the children all take after you. Your appearance shows nobility beyond words."
units.literal: The old father said: 'Just now, madam and the children were all judged noble because of you; your features show nobility beyond words.'

units.zh: 楊僕，宜陽人也。
units.en: Yang Pu came from Yiyang.
units.literal: Yang Pu was a man of Yiyang.

units.zh: 僕惶恐，對曰：「願盡死贖罪！」
units.en: Yang Pu stammered, "I will spend my life paying for these crimes!"
units.literal: Pu trembling replied: "Willing to exhaust death redeeming crime!"

units.zh: 南越反，拜為樓船將軍，有功，封將梁侯。
units.en: He commanded the tower-ship fleet against Southern Yue and won the marquisate of Jiangliang.
units.literal: Southern Yue rebelled—appointed tower-ship general—had merit—enfeoffed General Liang marquis.

units.zh: 還，免為庶人，病死。
units.en: Stripped of rank, he died a commoner.
units.literal: Returned—stripped to commoner—died of illness.

units.zh: 東越反，上欲復使將，為其伐前勞，以書敕責之曰：「將軍之功，獨有先破石門、尋狹，非有斬將騫旗之實也，烏足以驕人哉！
units.en: Planning a second campaign, the emperor sent a blistering edict: "General, your merit lies only in being first to break Shimen and Xinxia—you have no record of beheading enemy commanders or seizing their banners. How can that suffice to swagger before others?
units.literal: Eastern Yue rebelled—the sovereign wished to employ him again—because he boasted prior labor—with document rebuked saying: "General's merit—only first breaking Shimen and Xinxia—not having beheaded a general or seized banners—how enough to pride yourself before others!

units.zh: 後復與左將軍荀彘俱擊朝鮮，為彘所縛，語在《朝鮮傳》。
units.en: Later he campaigned in Korea beside General Xun Zhi and ended shackled—see the biography of Korea.
units.literal: Later again with Left General Xun Zhi attacked Korea—was bound by Zhi—the account stands in the Korea biography.

units.zh: 右渠，[12]危亡繼及，天命可畏，山川難恃。
units.en: Youqu met ruin in turn; Heaven's mandate is to be feared, and mountains and rivers cannot be relied upon.
units.literal: Youqu met ruin in turn; Heaven's mandate is to be feared, and mountains and rivers cannot be relied upon.

units.zh: 沈炯 虞荔 弟寄 馬樞
units.en: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu
units.literal: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu

units.zh: 遣盧綰、劉賈擊虜尉。
units.en: He sent Lu Wan and Liu Jia to attack and capture Wei.
units.literal: He sent Lu Wan and Liu Jia to attack and capture Wei.

units.zh: 於是諸侯王及 太尉長安侯臣綰等三百人，與博士稷嗣君叔孫通謹擇良日二月甲午，上尊號。
units.en: So the feudal lords and Grand Marshal, Marquis of Chang'an, Wan, and 300 others, together with the Erudite Lord Jisi, Shusun Tong, carefully chose an auspicious day, the jiawu day of the second month, and presented the honored title.
units.literal: So the feudal lords and Grand Marshal Lord Chang'an Chen Wan and 300 others, together with Erudite Ji, Successor Lord Shu Sun Tong, carefully chose an auspicious day, the jiawu day of the second month, and presented the honored title.

units.zh: 荊王臣信等十人皆曰：「太尉長安侯盧綰功最多，請立以為燕王。」
units.en: The King of Jing, Xin, and ten others all said: "Grand Marshal Lu Wan, Marquis of Chang'an, has the most merit. Please establish him as King of Yan."
units.literal: King Jing Chen Xin and ten others all said: "Grand Marshal Lord Chang'an Lu Wan has the most merit. Please establish him as King of Yan."

units.zh: 燕王綰、相國何等三十三人皆曰：「子恆賢知溫良， 請立以為代王，都晉陽。」
units.en: King Wan of Yan, Chancellor Xiao He, and thirty-three others all said: "The son Heng is worthy, wise, gentle, and kind. Please establish him as King of Dai, with his capital at Jinyang."
units.literal: King Yan Wan, prime minister He and thirty-three others all said: "The son Heng is worthy, wise, gentle, and kind. Please establish him as King of Dai, capital at Jinyang."

units.zh: 詔曰：「燕王綰與吾有故，愛之如子，聞與陳豨有謀，吾以為亡有，故使人迎綰。
units.en: The edict said: "King Lu Wan of Yan has old ties with me. I loved him like a son. When I heard that he had plotted with Chen Xi, I thought there was nothing to it, and so I sent people to welcome Lu Wan.
units.literal: The edict said: "King Yan Lu Wan has old relations with me. I love him like a son. Hearing he had plots with Chen Xi, I thought there was nothing to it, so I sent people to welcome Lu Wan.

units.zh: 春正月，追尊兄伯號曰武哀侯。
units.en: In the first month of spring, he posthumously honored his elder brother with the title Lord Wu'ai.
units.literal: In the first month of spring, he posthumously honored his elder brother with the title Lord Wu'ai.

units.zh: 燕王綰、相國何等請立子恢為梁王，子友為淮陽王。
units.en: King Yan Wan, prime minister He and others requested establishing son Hui as King of Liang, son You as King of Huaiyang.
units.literal: King Yan Wan, prime minister He and others requested establishing son Hui as King of Liang, son You as King of Huaiyang.

units.zh: 陳豨降將言豨反時燕王盧綰使人之豨所陰謀。
units.en: Chen Xi's surrendering generals said that when Xi rebelled, King Yan Lu Wan sent people to Xi's place with secret plots.
units.literal: Chen Xi's surrendering generals said that when Xi rebelled, King Yan Lu Wan sent people to Xi's place with secret plots.

units.zh: 上使辟陽侯審食其迎綰，綰稱疾。
units.en: The emperor sent Marquis Piyang Shen Shiqi to welcome Lu Wan. Lu Wan claimed illness.
units.literal: The emperor sent Marquis Piyang Shen Shiqi to welcome Lu Wan. Lu Wan claimed illness.

units.zh: 食其言綰反有端。
units.en: Shiqi said Lu Wan had signs of rebellion.
units.literal: Shiqi said Lu Wan had signs of rebellion.

units.zh: 春二 月，使樊噲、周勃將兵擊綰。
units.en: In the second month of spring, he sent Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo to lead troops to attack Lu Wan.
units.literal: In the second month of spring, he sent Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo to lead troops to attack Lu Wan.

units.zh: 綰稱疾不來，謀反明矣。
units.en: Lu Wan claimed illness and did not come. His rebellion is clear.
units.literal: Lu Wan claimed illness and did not come. His rebellion is clear.

units.zh: 與綰居，去來歸者，赦之，加爵亦一級。」
units.en: Those who lived with Lu Wan and come and go returning, pardon them, add one rank also."
units.literal: Those who lived with Lu Wan and come and go returning, pardon them, add one rank also."

units.zh: 盧綰與數千人居塞下候伺，幸上疾愈，自入謝。
units.en: Lu Wan with several thousand men dwelt below the frontier watching and waiting, hoping the emperor's illness would improve, personally entering to apologize.
units.literal: Lu Wan with several thousand men dwelt below the frontier watching and waiting, hoping the emperor's illness would improve, personally entering to apologize.

units.zh: 盧綰聞之，遂亡入匈奴。
units.en: Lu Wan heard of it and fled into the Xiongnu.
units.literal: Lu Wan heard of it and fled into the Xiongnu.
